messages:
mika: Quick check — who’s up for a small LAN on Friday night in the mezz? I can bring my Switch + Smash and a router for local-only games. :party_parrot:
ben: yes please. I’ll bring a spare power strip and ethernet switch (8-port).
carla: Count me in if I can snag a controller, mine died last week 😭
josh: I’ve got an extra Pro Controller and a couple Joy-Cons. Can bring Steam library for Rocket League / Speedrunners.
ciara: I can bring my gaming laptop and a USB hub. Any preference on start time? 7pm works for me.
mika: 7pm sounds good. Can whoever brings the router set SSID to redwood-lan and no internet? don’t want accidental downloads.
alex: I can do router. I’ll set SSID: redwood-lan-2 and password: bring-snacks (jk). Also will block WAN on it.
carla: Amazing, thank you alex! Do we have a sign-up for games so we don’t bottleneck Smash?
ben: quick poll: Smash bracket or freeplay? react with :trophy: for bracket, :video_game: for freeplay
lan-bot: Poll created — Smash bracket (7 votes), Freeplay (3 votes). Poll closes in 20h.
josh: Also, anyone want to trade Steam keys? I have an extra copy of Overcooked that I’d trade for something co-op.
ciara: I’ll take Overcooked if no one else claims it. :raised_hands:
mika: Perfect — ciara and josh, DM to arrange. Also reminder: bring headphones for PC games (mezz can echo).
ben: Packing list summary: power strip, 8-port switch, router (alex), controllers (josh), headphones, snacks. Anything else?
carla: A micro HDMI cable if someone wants to plug into the projector. I have one but can’t bring it till 6pm.
alex: Noted. I’ll bring that cable and a small surge protector.
ciara: Yesss snacks — I can bring chips and fizzy drinks. Anyone allergic to peanuts?
mika: no peanuts please (we have a teammate allergic), thanks!
ben: Sweet. I’ll pin this thread to the mezz event page. See you Friday :smile:
